input: Any commit that modifies /moves/knight_b8.text or /moves/pawn_d7.text must be co-signed by at least fifteen of the sixteen Black agents' keys in addition to the moving piece's own key, and any commit that modifies any /moves/<agent>.text path must also modify /turn/ply.num and be co-signed by knight_g8's key, so repeat off-plan pieces can never get a move accepted without near-unanimous team agreement.
response: always([+modifies(/moves/knight_b8.text) -signed_by(/team/pieces/knight_b8.id)] false) & always([+modifies(/moves/knight_b8.text) -threshold("15", /team/pieces)] false) & always([+modifies(/moves/pawn_d7.text) -signed_by(/team/pieces/pawn_d7.id)] false) & always([+modifies(/moves/pawn_d7.text) -threshold("15", /team/pieces)] false) & always([+modifies(/moves/$k.text) -modifies(/turn/ply.num)] false) & always([+modifies(/moves/$k.text) -signed_by(/team/pieces/knight_g8.id)] false)
